notes.title: You,Calligrapher Update
notes.notes:
Dear Calligrapher： 

The new version  was updated~ This update includes: 

1. Increase the effect of the Mid-Autumn Festival, which will be opened for two weeks before and after the Mid-Autumn Festival every year
2. Fixed the problem that the VR perspective is fixed when the third-person perspective is enabled (PC only)
3.Fixed the problem that the number of completed levels for some achievements was incorrectly calculated 

If you have any questions, just leave comments.
Thanks to your love for the game, we are very grateful. 

Cheers, 
Patha Pradipa

notes.title: You, Calligrapher 1.0.2.3 patch note
notes.notes:
Dear friends, We have released You, Calligrapher 1.0.2.3 update today. We added new features in the game. 
- 3 new seals added into the game, you can click the “seals” button to change your seals.
- Now you can import your favorite picture as seal picture. 
Route: Documents/YouCalligrapher/Seals
  *Recommended size: 512*1024 (Aspect ratio 1:2)
- Frames improvement

notes.title: Mid-Autumn Festival patch note
notes.notes:
Mid-Autumn Festival is coming, we added some Mid-Autumn Festival elements in this game. This event will start from the update date until the next version update. 
We wish all players a happy Mid-Autumn Festival~

—Mid-Autumn Festival elements
—Three Mid-Autumn Festival theme templates

notes.title: YouCalligrapher 1.02 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello YouCalligrapher players. We’ve just released YouCalligrapher version 1.02. This one comes with a list of new stuff and improvement for the base game. Full changelog is below.

—New function of using laser to pick up or place object.
—Add a jade erase pen on the left of the pen holder.
—New function to select works for secondary editing by clicking the “My Work” bottom.
—New function of saving your works in Challenge mode.
—Now players can import songs to the game.
—Now players can import Pictures to the game.
—New Function of Third Personal View function.

notes.title: 《You, Calligrapher》Full-Release Content Wishboard
notes.notes:
Hi Calligraphers,

It's been almost a month since the release of the You, Calligrapher, we've seen many great arts in the community!!

(If you haven't, check the Community HUB or join our Discord)

Thanks for liking the game, and for joining the community and the game in this early stage.We will be releasing our EA Roadmap as soon as possilbe, hopefully in Mid-June, and with it, a first game update.

Yet what we value the most is the feedback from you all. 
So please:


 Comment below for whatever you would like to see in the Full-Release of the game.
 Or join the Community Discussion
 Or find Devs in Discord


Here are some of the most mentioned features:
[olist]
 New scenes (Tell us what scene you would like to see)
 Rotate the table, resize the table
 Customize music and stamp
 Templates and Challenges of other languages(Please suggest a language)
[/olist]

---
